item.title: Understanding Vault Standards: EIP-4626 and Beyond
item.author: dev@antomor.com (Antonio Morrone)
item.description: While researching vault standards to inform the design of a planned vault product on Rootstock, it became clear pretty quickly that “use ERC-4626” wasn’t the whole answer. The base standard covers a lot, but it also assumes a specific shape (one share token, one asset, everything settling synchronously) that doesn’t fit every vault a real product might need. I put together an internal walkthrough for the team, covering ERC-4626 and the standards that extend it, for exactly the cases where the base spec runs out. This post is that walkthrough.
